component.name: PaperPilot
component.summary: Privacy-first, local multi-surface PDF and document intelligence toolkit

description.p: PaperPilot is a fast, local-first document manipulation toolkit with over 90 operations. Designed with privacy by default: your files never leave your device.

ul.li: Merge, split, rotate, organize, and reorder PDF pages
Local OCR text extraction and scanned document searchability
High-ratio compression and vector stream deduplication
Digital signatures, PIN encryption, and AcroForm processing
Integrated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for local AI agent workflows

screenshot.caption: Main application workspace with document preview and quick tools dock
Visual pipeline canvas for multi-step PDF batch operations

description.p: Release 0.6.0 with 91 tools, unmocked Tauri GUI test coverage, and offline-first intelligence.
